targets.authors: Selman C, Lingard S, Choudhury AI, Batterham RL, Claret M, et al.
targets.title: Evidence for lifespan extension and delayed age-related biomarkers in insulin receptor substrate 1 null mice.
targets.evidence_quote: In the current study we examined lifespan in a second, independent cohort of female WT and Irs1 −/− mice to determine whether our original finding was indeed repeatable.
targets.outcome_quote: In conclusion, we replicate and validate our previous finding [12] that global deletion of Irs1 induces a robust lifespan extension in female mice.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Female lifespan extension replicated in an independent cohort. The completed and augmented male cohort instead showed lifespan extension, explicitly contrasted with the original male null result. The concluding confirmation is limited to females, rather than a verdict covering both sexes. Male contrast: We also show that, in contrast to our earlier study [12] , a completed and augmented lifespan study in male mice indicates that median lifespan is extended in male Irs1 −/− mice by ∼16%.

reasoning: Independent female cohort directly re-tests reference 12. Male follow-up incorporates original animals and additional littermates and is explicitly compared with the same target; this yields mixed agreement across the reported findings. Other longevity studies are background, not targets.
